description: Ministry of Higher Education and Highways -  Order to amend the Gazette Ex. No. 1093/08 of 17.08.1999 by adding Faculty of Applied Sciences  to the University  of Wayamba
reasoning: This gazette content is an order made under Section 27(1) of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, which amends the academic structure (faculties and departments) of the Wayamba University of Sri Lanka. It constitutes a legal/regulatory action that modifies existing statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation, falling squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it is signed by a named minister, the core content is about amending a legal order and its schedule, not about the minister's personal appointment or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
